_readme: Sample answer file for the interactive tasks in fleet-component-recovery-plan.json, consumed via Import-VCFIRAnswerFile.

Keyed by cmdlet name. Get-BackupsFromSFTPServer is called 4 times in this plan (VCFMS, Log Management, VCF Automation, Telemetry, in that order) - each value is an array of answer sets, one per invocation.

Get-BackupsFromSFTPServer's own prompts (pick a backup group, optional per-component custom picks, final Y/N) vary with how many backups/components are found on the SFTP server - the values below assume a single matching backup and no custom overrides, and MUST be reviewed against your own environment's real prompts before use.

Confirm-ManualStep is different from every other key here: its value is a single FLAT array of pre-approved -AnswerKey strings, not an array of answer sets. This plan has 5 manual 'Press Enter once X is done' gates. Only 4 are pre-approved below, on purpose: this demonstrates SELECTIVE answering - a gate whose key is omitted always still blocks for a real Enter press, even with this answer file loaded and every other cmdlet running unattended. 'license-server-redeployed' is deliberately left OUT here as an example of a gate an operator might always want to confirm by hand regardless of what else is automated.
Run each task interactively once first to see its real prompts/IDs, then transcribe your answers here in the same order.
Every key below is optional. Omit a cmdlet to answer at the console. A listed cmdlet fails if its answers run out or a supplied value is invalid.

The confirmations below correspond to two cluster-entry removals and two runtime deployments (VCFMS, then VCF Automation), one scale operation, and four restores (VCFMS, Log Management, VCF Automation, Telemetry).
